'''Vindo''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. She led the Republic garrison on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Dantooine Incursion|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Nova Blades]].<ref name="Dantooine" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Vindo is a character from [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]. She first appeared as one of the Republic contacts for "The Pirate Incursion" event on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Zai-Uram]]. She can be flirted with by players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]].<ref name="Dantooine" />
